note: R3.0C C2_LAP_AUTHORITY state. Four authorized renderer/js production paths: the C1 adapter (production_adapter_present) plus three C2 services — lap-authority (lap_authority_present), track-identity (track_identity_authoritative) and distance-authority (lap_authority_present, secondary). algorithmsAllowed flips true here because C2 is the algorithmCheckpoint per schema.json — lap authority is re-derived from raw evidence rather than trusted from caller claims, the lap-authority service computes coverage / sample count / discontinuity from fixture-derived conservative thresholds (DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS marked calibrationStatus='fixture_derived_pending_field_validation', evidence carries 'thresholds_fixture_calibrated_not_field_validated' limitation), track identity is decided only from explicit {trackId, layoutId, source:'explicit'} (no inference from name / filename / lap length / sample shape / GPS), and distance authority accepts only authorityStatus='channel_source_declared' (sample-index, elapsed-time ratio, speed integral, GPS proximity, track-length guess all enumerated and refused). uiAllowed / featureRegistryActivationAllowed remain false: UI lives at C7_UI, activation at C8_ACTIVATION. Normalized distance / corner segmentation / pairing / delta metrics / export remain locked behind C3..C6. The three R3.0C feature IDs (case_comparison, reference_lap, corner_delta) remain availability='deferred' in renderer/js/feature-registry.js with NO rendererAdapter until C8 authorizes activation.
